title: Publishing connections
name: Name
saved: Connection saved. Existing plans keep their original target version.
tested: Directory access and atomic link switching verified. No site was published.
hint: Configure a dedicated local or SFTP destination. Saving a connection does not publish a site.
immutable: The target identity and directory cannot change after creation. Create a new connection for another target.
noConnections: Create a connection to publish this site.
invalidUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) URL ending with a slash, without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
invalidPath: Use a directory within a configured root. Symlinks and parent paths are not allowed.
invalidRoots: Publication roots are not configured correctly.
notFound: This publishing connection is unavailable to your account.
conflict: The connection changed. Reload it before saving or testing.
targetInUse: This directory already contains files or belongs to another connection. Choose an empty, dedicated directory.
targetChanged: The registered destination changed. Review the connection before publishing.
protectedPath: Publication targets cannot overlap source or application data directories.
limit: The connection limit has been reached.
unavailable: The connection could not be checked. Verify the volume and directory permissions.
identityRequired: Sign in with a PandaForce administrator or IDAAS account to manage publishing connections.
sftpHint: Use an empty, dedicated absolute directory. Obtain the SHA256 host fingerprint from your server administrator through a trusted channel. This connector requires symlinks, exclusive link creation, fsync and OpenSSH POSIX rename.
credentialConfigured: Credentials configured · revision {version, number}. Enter a replacement only when needed.
credentialNeeded: Save credentials before testing this connection.
credentialPrivacy: Credentials are encrypted on the server and never returned by connection APIs. This form is not saved in browser drafts. Replacing credentials invalidates prepared publication plans.
unsupportedConnector: This connection type does not support that operation.
invalidHostKey: Enter the full SHA256 host key fingerprint, such as SHA256: followed by 43 base64 characters.
invalidCredential: Check the password, private key and key passphrase.
credentialMissing: This connection has no saved credentials. Save them before testing or publishing.
credentialConflict: Credentials changed. Reload the connection before trying again.
keyUnavailable: The connection encryption key is unavailable. Restore its original key file; existing credentials cannot be recovered with a new key.
unreadableCredential: The stored credential could not be decrypted. Check the encryption key and backup.
refreshFailed: Credential refresh failed. Reconnect the account.
connectionFailed: Could not connect to the SFTP server. Check the address, port and network.
hostKeyMismatch: The server host key does not match the trusted fingerprint. No credentials were sent. Verify the server identity.
authenticationFailed: The SFTP server rejected authentication. Check the username and credentials.
disconnected: The SFTP connection was interrupted or exceeded its time limit.
notFoundRemote: The remote path was not found.
permissionDenied: The SSH account cannot access this directory.
unsupported: This server lacks the required atomic publication capabilities. Use a compatible SFTP server or export the site for manual deployment.
invalidRemotePath: The remote directory contains unmanaged files, a symlink or another connection’s marker. Choose a dedicated empty directory.
remoteLimit: The remote directory exceeds inspection limits. Review retained releases and temporary probes.
operationFailed: The SFTP server could not complete the directory operation. Check permissions and server capabilities.
keyWorkLimit: This key exceeds the supported work limit (64 OpenSSH bcrypt rounds or 8192 RSA bits). Use a dedicated publication key within these limits.
trustHint: Use this only after confirming a legitimate server key change through a trusted channel. The server, account and directory stay the same. Existing publication plans become invalid.
trustAcknowledgement: I verified this fingerprint with the server administrator.
trustUnverified: Test this connection to verify the replacement host fingerprint before preparing a new publication.
trustUpdated: Trusted fingerprint replaced. Test the connection before preparing a new publication.
refreshed: Current connection details loaded. Unsaved credentials have been cleared.
